author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating to human: workspace-wide Clone-derive policy on Params structs. The bead author preferred option A (add Clone to canonical mail-client's 5 Params structs, propagate to all siblings — calendars direction wins). The Clone derive remains on CalendarEventGetParams pending this decision (carried over from the JMAP-1j9k.10/.9/.11 commit). The decision impacts canonical mail-client and the workspace-wide Params struct family.

Note this bead is labelled 'opinion' already; the engineering argument is borderline but the canonical-template propagation rule is the binding concern.

Skipping in /do-beads loop.
